produtos.body: Formulated with high-purity PDRN extracted from salmon, this elasticity-boosting solution delivers deep hydration and firming care to weakened, sagging skin. PDRN, a DNA-based ingredient derived from salmon reproductive cells, is known for promoting collagen production and accelerating skin regeneration. Just 5 to 10 milliliters can be extracted from a single fish, making it an exceptionally rare and valuable ingredient often used in medical-grade skin treatments. Packed with 99% ultra-pure PDRN, the formula penetrates deeply between the gaps in dry and depleted skin, restoring bounce and elasticity from within. Its clinical-grade concentration ensures visible improvement in skin firmness, hydration, and resilience.
